An Admin types it.\n    \"\"\"\n    if account.role == policy.ADMIN:\n        byline = _typed_byline(form[\"byline_name\"], form[\"byline_class_year\"])\n    elif existing is not None:\n        byline = existing[\"byline_name\"], existing[\"byline_class_year\"]\n    else:\n        byline = account.name, account.class_year\n\n    trip_id = form[\"trip_id\"]\n    error = (BYLINE_ERROR if byline is None\n             else TRIP_ERROR if not trip_id.isdigit()\n             or trips.get_trip(int(trip_id)) is None\n             else TITLE_ERROR if not form[\"title\"].strip()\n             else SLUG_ERROR if not form[\"slug\"].strip()\n             else SLUG_UNSAFE_ERROR if not is_url_safe(form[\"slug\"].strip())\n             else BODY_ERROR if not form[\"body\"].strip() else None)\n    if not error:\n        try:\n            save(int(trip_id), form[\"title\"].strip(), form[\"slug\"].strip(),\n                 form[\"body\"], *byline)\n        except recaps.SlugTaken:\n            error = SLUG_TAKEN_ERROR\n        except recaps.RecapLocked:\n            raise HTTPException(409, LOCKED_ERROR)\n        else:\n            if existing is not None and existing[\"status\"] == \"published\":\n                flash(request, LIVE_NOTICE)\n    if error:\n        return _form(request, account, form, action, title, error, 400,\n                     recap=existing)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/recaps\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_recaps(request: Request,\n                account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    # Editors see only their own Recaps; A refusal is a 403 or a 409 and changes nothing.\"\"\"\n    recap = _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, policy_action)\n    if action == \"submit\" and not recap[\"body\"].strip():\n        raise HTTPException(400, SUBMIT_EMPTY_ERROR)\n    if action == \"publish\" and images_without_alt(\n            recap[\"body\"], _image_urls(recap_id)):\n        raise HTTPException(400, ALT_PUBLISH_ERROR)\n    try:\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, action)\n    except recaps.TransitionRefused:\n        raise HTTPException(409, TRANSITION_ERROR)\n    if action == \"unpublish\":\n        flash(request, LIVE_NOTICE)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/recaps\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                 account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"submit\", \"recaps.submit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/send-back\")\ndef send_back_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                    account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.send_back\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"send-back\", \"recaps.send_back\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                  account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.publish\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"publish\", \"recaps.publish\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/unpublish\")\ndef unpublish_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                    account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.unpublish\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"unpublish\", \"recaps.unpublish\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{recap_id}/images/{filename}\")\ndef show_image(recap_id: int, filename: str,\n               account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    \"\"\"The console's copy of an Image. Preview's `images/<file>` resolves here.\"\"\"\n    _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, \"recaps.view\")\n    image = next((i for i in images.list_images(recap_id)\n                  if i[\"filename\"] == filename), None)\n    path = settings.UPLOADS / filename\n    if image is None or not path.is_file():\n        raise HTTPException(404, \"No such Image\")\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=image[\"content_type\"],\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/images\")\ndef upload_image(recap_id: int, request: account, \"recaps.edit\")\n    data = file.file.read(images.MAX_BYTES + 1) if file else None\n    try:\n        image = images.add_image(recap_id, data, alt, _editor_id(account))\n    except recaps.create_recap(\n                     fields[0], account.id, *fields[1:]))\n\"\"\"Site state: the single record of when `cms publish` last rendered the Public\nsite. T08's \"changes not yet live\" notice compares content edit times against it.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_NOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\"\n\n\ndef record_render() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Stamp now as the time the Public site was last rendered.\"\"\"\n    db.init_db()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            f\"INSERT INTO site_state (id, last_rendered_at) VALUES (1, {_NOW}) \"\n            f\"ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET last_rendered_at = {_NOW}\")\n\n\ndef last_rendered() -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"When the Public site was last rendered, or None if it never has.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT last_rendered_at FROM site_state WHERE id = 1\").fetchone()\n    return row[\"last_rendered_at\"] if row else None\n\"\"\"Recaps: one member's account of one Trip, and the status machine that moves\nthem from Draft to Published.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db, images\n\n\nclass RecapLocked(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's write found the Recap no longer their own Draft.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Another Recap on this Trip already uses this Slug.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Appended to an Editor's write so the write itself checks what the policy\n# checked a moment earlier; the Recap may have been Submitted in between.\n_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY = \" AND status = 'draft' AND owner_id = ?\"\n\n\ndef get_recap(recap_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"One Recap with its Owner's name, or None.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id WHERE recap.id = ?\",\n            (recap_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef update_recap(recap_id: int, trip_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int,\n                 editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Overwrite a Recap's editable fields and stamp the edit time. The Owner,\n    status and created time never change here. Raises SlugTaken on a clash.\n\n    Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: the write then applies only if that Editor\n    still owns a Draft, checked in the UPDATE itself, else RecapLocked.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE recap SET trip_id = ?, title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, \"\n                \"byline_name = ?, byline_class_year = ?, \"\n                \"edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') \"\n                f\"WHERE id = ?{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n                (trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name, byline_class_year,\n                 recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n            if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n                raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef list_recaps(owner_id: int | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Recaps with Trip and Owner names, newest first; only owner_id's if given.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, trip.conference AS trip_name, \"\n            \"account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN trip ON trip.id = recap.trip_id \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id \"\n            \"WHERE (? IS NULL OR recap.owner_id = ?) \"\n            \"ORDER BY recap.created_at DESC, recap.id DESC\",\n            (owner_id, owner_id)).fetchall()\n\n\ndef delete_recap(recap_id: int, editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Recap. Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: it is deleted only if\n    that Editor still owns a Draft, checked in the DELETE itself, else\n    RecapLocked. Its Images go with it, files included.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        filenames = [row[\"filename\"] for row in conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT filename FROM image WHERE recap_id = ?\", (recap_id,))]\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            f\"DELETE FROM recap WHERE id = ?\"\n            f\"{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n            (recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n        if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM image WHERE recap_id = ?\", (recap_id,))\n    images.remove_files(filenames)\n\n\ndef create_recap(trip_id: int, owner_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Insert a Draft Recap; return its id. The Body is stored as written.\n\n    Raises SlugTaken if the Trip already has a Recap with this Slug. The\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug) constraint decides, so two simultaneous saves\n    cannot both win.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO recap (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, \"\n                \"byline_name, byline_class_year) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, byline_name,\n                 byline_class_year))\n            return cur.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\nclass TransitionRefused(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The Recap is not in a status this action can start from.\"\"\"\n\n\n# action -> (statuses it may start from, status it ends in). Who may do each\n# action is the policy's business, not this table's.\nTRANSITIONS: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]] = {\n    \"submit\": ((\"draft\",), \"submitted\"),\n    \"send-back\": ((\"submitted\",), \"draft\"),\n    \"publish\": ((\"draft\", \"submitted\"), \"published\"),\n    \"unpublish\": ((\"published\",), \"draft\"),\n}\n\n\n# Publishing stamps the time; Unpublishing clears it.\nPUBLISHED_AT_SQL = {\n    \"publish\": \", published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\",\n    \"unpublish\": \", published_at = NULL\",\n}\n\n\ndef transition(recap_id: int, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Move a Recap along `action`. The status is checked inside the UPDATE, so\n    two simultaneous requests cannot both move it. Raises TransitionRefused.\"\"\"\n    from_statuses, to_status = TRANSITIONS[action]\n    marks = \", \".join(\"?\" for _ in from_statuses)\n    stamp = PUBLISHED_AT_SQL.get(action, \"\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            f\"UPDATE recap SET status = ?{stamp} WHERE id = ? \"\n            f\"AND status IN ({marks})\",\n            (to_status, recap_id, *from_statuses))\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise TransitionRefused(action)\n\"\"\"The permission policy: can this Account do this action to this object?\n\nEvery route asks `can` (through `security.require`); routes never check roles\nthemselves. Unknown actions are denied. Add an action here when a ticket adds a\ncapability. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"pages.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    return True\n\"\"\"SQLite access. The database path is read from settings on every call.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    class_year    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    conference TEXT NOT NULL,\n    city       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,\n    end_date   TEXT NOT NULL,\n    summary    TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recap (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    trip_id           INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trip (id),\n    owner_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title             TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_name       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_class_year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                      CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    published_at      TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    owner_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title        TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body         TEXT NOT NULL,\n    nav_position INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status {"parentUuid":"08b91d8e-e342-4916-9702-f384af95af7f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"510df76d-23df-4c6a-b4db-4a6f34f42a94","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012nNBcCq5giLdurhGp6NeoM","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Site state: the single record of when `cms publish` last rendered the Public\nsite. T08's \"changes not yet live\" notice compares content edit times against it.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_NOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\"\n\n\ndef record_render() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Stamp now as the time the Public site was last rendered.\"\"\"\n    db.init_db()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            f\"INSERT INTO site_state (id, last_rendered_at) VALUES (1, {_NOW}) \"\n            f\"ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET last_rendered_at = {_NOW}\")\n\n\ndef last_rendered() -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"When the Public site was last rendered, or None if it never has.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT last_rendered_at FROM site_state WHERE id = 1\").fetchone()\n    return row[\"last_rendered_at\"] if row else None\n\"\"\"The permission policy: can this Account do this action to this object?\n\nEvery route asks `can` (through `security.require`); routes never check roles\nthemselves. Unknown actions are denied. Add an action here when a ticket adds a\ncapability. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"pages.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    return True\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF and the route guard.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, itsdangerous\nunderneath) holding the Account id and a CSRF token. The Account itself is\nreread from the database on every request.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, policy\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\nLOGIN_URL = \"/login\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def csrf_protect(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: refuse any state-changing request without the token.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"Missing or invalid CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Reread the signed-in Account; a Deactivated one counts as signed out.\"\"\"\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = accounts.get(account_id) if account_id else None\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n        return None\n    return account\n\n\ndef require(action: str) -> Callable[..., Account]:\n    \"\"\"Route dependency: logged out -> login page, not allowed -> 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def guard(account: Account | None = Depends(current_account)) -> Account:\n        if account is None:\n            raise HTTPException(303, headers={\"Location\": LOGIN_URL})\n        if not policy.can(account, action):\n            raise HTTPException(403, \"You do not have permission to do that\")\n        return account\n\n    return guard\n\"\"\"Recaps: one member's account of one Trip, and the status machine that moves\nthem from Draft to Published.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db, images\n\n\nclass RecapLocked(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's write found the Recap no longer their own Draft.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Another Recap on this Trip already uses this Slug.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Appended to an Editor's write so the write itself checks what the policy\n# checked a moment earlier; the Recap may have been Submitted in between.\n_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY = \" AND status = 'draft' AND owner_id = ?\"\n\n\ndef get_recap(recap_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"One Recap with its Owner's name, or None.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id WHERE recap.id = ?\",\n            (recap_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef update_recap(recap_id: int, trip_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int,\n                 editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Overwrite a Recap's editable fields and stamp the edit time. The Owner,\n    status and created time never change here. Raises SlugTaken on a clash.\n\n    Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: the write then applies only if that Editor\n    still owns a Draft, checked in the UPDATE itself, else RecapLocked.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE recap SET trip_id = ?, title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, \"\n                \"byline_name = ?, byline_class_year = ?, \"\n                \"edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') \"\n                f\"WHERE id = ?{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n                (trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name, byline_class_year,\n                 recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n            if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n                raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef list_recaps(owner_id: int | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Recaps with Trip and Owner names, newest first; only owner_id's if given.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, trip.conference AS trip_name, \"\n            \"account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN trip ON trip.id = recap.trip_id \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id \"\n            \"WHERE (? IS NULL OR recap.owner_id = ?) \"\n            \"ORDER BY recap.created_at DESC, recap.id DESC\",\n            (owner_id, owner_id)).fetchall()\n\n\ndef delete_recap(recap_id: int, editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Recap. Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: it is deleted only if\n    that Editor still owns a Draft, checked in the DELETE itself, else\n    RecapLocked. Its Images go with it, files included.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        filenames = [row[\"filename\"] for row in conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT filename FROM image WHERE recap_id = ?\", (recap_id,))]\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            f\"DELETE FROM recap WHERE id = ?\"\n            f\"{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n            (recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n        if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM image WHERE recap_id = ?\", (recap_id,))\n    images.remove_files(filenames)\n\n\ndef create_recap(trip_id: int, owner_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Insert a Draft Recap; return its id. The Body is stored as written.\n\n    Raises SlugTaken if the Trip already has a Recap with this Slug. The\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug) constraint decides, so two simultaneous saves\n    cannot both win.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO recap (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, \"\n                \"byline_name, byline_class_year) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, byline_name,\n                 byline_class_year))\n            return cur.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\nclass TransitionRefused(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The Recap is not in a status this action can start from.\"\"\"\n\n\n# action -> (statuses it may start from, status it ends in). Who may do each\n# action is the policy's business, not this table's.\nTRANSITIONS: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]] = {\n    \"submit\": ((\"draft\",), \"submitted\"),\n    \"send-back\": ((\"submitted\",), \"draft\"),\n    \"publish\": ((\"draft\", \"submitted\"), \"published\"),\n    \"unpublish\": ((\"published\",), \"draft\"),\n}\n\n\n# Publishing stamps the time; Unpublishing clears it.\nPUBLISHED_AT_SQL = {\n    \"publish\": \", published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\",\n    \"unpublish\": \", published_at = NULL\",\n}\n\n\ndef transition(recap_id: int, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Move a Recap along `action`. The status is checked inside the UPDATE, so\n    two simultaneous requests cannot both move it. Raises TransitionRefused.\"\"\"\n    from_statuses, to_status = TRANSITIONS[action]\n    marks = \", \".join(\"?\" for _ in from_statuses)\n    stamp = PUBLISHED_AT_SQL.get(action, \"\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            f\"UPDATE recap SET status = ?{stamp} WHERE id = ? \"\n            f\"AND status IN ({marks})\",\n            (to_status, recap_id, *from_statuses))\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise TransitionRefused(action)\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block header %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"/logout\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    {{ account.name }} ({{ account.role }}) <button type=\"submit\">Sign out</button>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>T00: hello admin</h1>\n  <p>You are signed in to the admin console.</p>\n{% endblock %}\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block header %}{% include \"admin/_header.html\" %}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Recaps</h1>\n  <p><a href=\"/admin/recaps/new\">New Recap</a></p>\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>Title</th><th>Trip</th><th>Byline</th><th>Owner</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody>\n    {% for r in recaps %}\n      <tr>\n        <td><a href=\"/admin/recaps/{{ r.id }}\">{{ r.title }}</a></td>\n        <td>{{ r.trip_name }}</td>\n        <td>{{ r.byline_name }} '{{ r.byline_class_year % 100 }}</td>\n        <td>{{ r.owner_name }}</td><td>{{ r.status | capitalize }}</td>\n        <td>\n          <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/recaps/{{ r.id }}/delete\">\n            <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n            <button type=\"submit\">Delete</button>\n          </form>\n        </td>\n      </tr>\n    {% endfor %}\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n{% endblock %}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"0453b38a-1695-4385-8c31-00798d1dee7f","timestamp":"2026-10-24T17:32:37.307Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Site state: the single record of when `cms publish` last rendered the Public\nsite. The\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug) constraint decides, so two simultaneous saves\n    cannot both win.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO recap (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, \"\n                \"byline_name, byline_class_year) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, byline_name,\n                 byline_class_year))\n            return cur.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\nclass TransitionRefused(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The Recap is not in a status this action can start from.\"\"\"\n\n\n# action -> (statuses it may start from, status it ends in). Who may do each\n# action is the policy's business, not this table's.\nTRANSITIONS: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]] = {\n    \"submit\": ((\"draft\",), \"submitted\"),\n    \"send-back\": ((\"submitted\",), \"draft\"),\n    \"publish\": ((\"draft\", \"submitted\"), \"published\"),\n    \"unpublish\": ((\"published\",), \"draft\"),\n}\n\n\n# Publishing stamps the time; Unpublishing clears it.\nPUBLISHED_AT_SQL = {\n    \"publish\": \", published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\",\n    \"unpublish\": \", published_at = NULL\",\n}\n\n\ndef transition(recap_id: int, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Move a Recap along `action`. The real\n# script reads passwords from the environment; in tests they are fixed and\n# meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": seed.ADMIN_EMAIL, \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": seed.EDITOR_EMAIL, \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\"},\n}\n\nTOKEN_FIELD = re.compile(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"')\n\n\ndef csrf_from(response) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the hidden CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = TOKEN_FIELD.search(response.text)\n    assert match, \"page has no csrf_token field\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database file, seeded with the demo Accounts.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n    db.init_db()\n    seed.seed_accounts(DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"],\n                       DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"][\"password\"])\n    return settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client(database) -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\ndef log_in(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\"))\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as(database):\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        response = log_in(c, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n\"\"\"T07: Pages and the Navigation bar.\n\nSeams: the HTTP app (TestClient) and `app.publish.render_site(out)`. Pages are\nset up through the real routes, then the output folder is read back as a reader\nwould see it. Routes under test (all Admin-only):\n\n    GET  /admin/pages[?status=draft|published]      the list, filterable\n    GET  /admin/pages/new                           the New Page editor\n    POST /admin/pages                               create (always a Draft)\n    GET  /admin/pages/{id}                          the editor\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}                          save\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}/delete\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}/publish | unpublish\n    POST /admin/pages/preview                       (the New Page editor)\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}/preview                  (an existing Page's editor)\n\nThe form fields are title, slug, body and nav_position. Preview re-renders the\neditor with the sanitized Body inside <section id=\"preview\">. On the Public\nsite a Published Page is written at `<slug>/index.html`, and every page carries\na <nav> with Home first, then the Published Pages by nav position.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport   html = admin.get(PAGES).text\n    match = re.search(\n        rf'<a href=\"/admin/pages/(\\d+)\">{re.escape(title)}</a>', html)\n    assert match, f\"{title!r} is not in the Pages list\"\n    return import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    class_year    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    conference TEXT NOT NULL,\n    city       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,\n    end_date   TEXT NOT NULL,\n    summary    TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recap (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    trip_id           INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trip (id),\n    owner_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title             TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_name       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_class_year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                      CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    published_at      TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    owner_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title        TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body         TEXT NOT NULL,\n    nav_position INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS image (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    recap_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recap (id),\n    filename     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    content_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n    size         INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    alt          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_state (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),\n    last_rendered_at  TEXT\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open a connection; commit on success, roll back on error, always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    except BaseException:\n        conn.rollback()\n        raise\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _add_column_if_missing(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str,\n                           definition: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never alters a table that already exists, so\n    a column added to SCHEMA later is added here for databases made before it.\"\"\"\n    existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    if column not in existing:\n        try:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:\n            # Another process started at the same moment and added it first.\n            if \"duplicate column name\" not in str(exc):\n                raise\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_column_if_missing(conn, \"recap\", \"published_at\", The real\n# script reads passwords from the environment; in tests they are fixed and\n# meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": seed.ADMIN_EMAIL, \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": seed.EDITOR_EMAIL, \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\"},\n}\n\nTOKEN_FIELD = re.compile(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"')\n\n\ndef csrf_from(response) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the hidden CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = TOKEN_FIELD.search(response.text)\n    assert match, \"page has no csrf_token field\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database file, seeded with the demo Accounts.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n    db.init_db()\n    seed.seed_accounts(DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"],\n                       DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"][\"password\"])\n    return settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client(database) -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\ndef log_in(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\"))\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as(database):\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        response = log_in(c, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n\"\"\"T07: Pages and the Navigation bar.\n\nSeams: the HTTP app (TestClient) and `app.publish.render_site(out)`. Pages are\nset up through the real routes, then the output folder is read back as a reader\nwould see it. Routes under test (all Admin-only):\n\n    GET  /admin/pages[?status=draft|published]      the list, filterable\n    GET  /admin/pages/new                           the New Page editor\n    POST /admin/pages                               create (always a Draft)\n    GET  /admin/pages/{id}                          the editor\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}                          save\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}/delete\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}/publish | unpublish\n    POST /admin/pages/preview                       (the New Page editor)\n    POST /admin/pages/{id}/preview                  (an existing Page's editor)\n\nThe form fields are title, slug, body and nav_position. Preview re-renders the\neditor with the sanitized Body inside <section id=\"preview\">. On the Public\nsite a Published Page is written at `<slug>/index.html`, and every page carries\na <nav> with Home first, then the Published Pages by nav position.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport filename     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    content_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n    size         INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    alt          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_state (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),\n    last_rendered_at  TEXT\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open a connection; commit on success, roll back on error, always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    except BaseException:\n        conn.rollback()\n        raise\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _add_column_if_missing(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str,\n                           definition: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never alters a table that already exists, so\n    a column added to SCHEMA later is added here for databases made before it.\"\"\"\n    existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    if column not in existing:\n        try:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:\n            # Another process started at the same moment and added it first.\n            if \"duplicate column name\" not in str(exc):\n                raise\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_column_if_missing(conn, \"recap\", \"published_at\", IS NULL OR page.status = ?) \"\n            \"ORDER BY page.nav_position, page.title, page.id\",\n            (status, status)).fetchall()\n\n\ndef create_page(owner_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                nav_position: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Insert a Draft Page; return its id. The Body is stored as written.\n    Raises SlugTaken; the UNIQUE constraint decides.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO page (owner_id, title, slug, body, nav_position) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (owner_id, title, slug, body, nav_position))\n            return cur.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef update_page(page_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                nav_position: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Overwrite a Page's editable fields and stamp the edit time. The Owner,\n    status and created time never change here. Raises SlugTaken.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE page SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, \"\n                \"nav_position = ?, \"\n                \"edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') \"\n                \"WHERE id = ?\", (title, slug, body, nav_position, page_id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM page WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n\n\ndef transition(page_id: int, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Publish or Unpublish. The status is checked inside the UPDATE, so two\n    simultaneous requests cannot both move it. Raises TransitionRefused.\"\"\"\n    from_status, to_status = TRANSITIONS[action]\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"UPDATE page SET status = ? WHERE id = ? \"\n                           \"AND status = ?\", (to_status, page_id, from_status))\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise TransitionRefused(action)\napp/recaps.py:57:def list_recaps(owner_id: int | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\napp/routes/recaps.py:145:def list_recaps(request: Request,\napp/routes/recaps.py:150:        request, \"admin/recaps.html\",\napp/routes/recaps.py:152:         \"recaps\": recaps.list_recaps(owner_id)})\nhooks/\nskills/\nstate/\nsettings.json  638B\n[project]\nname = \"iphs400-mp2-cms\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\ndescription = \"IPHS 400 MP2 — a small web CMS with a local admin console and a static public site\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.12\"\ndependencies = [\n    \"fastapi>=0.115\",\n    \"uvicorn[standard]>=0.32\",\n    \"jinja2>=3.1\",\n    \"python-multipart>=0.0.12\",   # {"parentUuid":"54b00ea8-ddc8-48c4-a2b8-d76896f08de4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMTpmpn6cKaTG8gjk2Bm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NM5RxJLp4tWiue8DB67YWE","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t08.py","content":"\"\"\"T08: Dashboard and content list.\n\nSeams: the HTTP app (TestClient). Data is set up with the app's own write\nfunctions and routes; the pages are read back as a console user sees them.\n\n    GET /admin                                       the dashboard\n    GET /admin/recaps[?status=&trip=&owner=]         the Recaps list\n\nMarkup contract the tests read (the ticket leaves it open):\n\n* Each dashboard count is an element carrying `data-count=\"<key>\"` whose text is\n  the number. Admin keys: recaps-draft, recaps-submitted, recaps-published,\n  trips, pages-draft, pages-published, accounts-active. An Editor's dashboard\n  has the three recaps-* keys only.\n* The \"changes not yet live\" notice is the phrase \"changes not yet live\" on the\n  Admin dashboard, and appears nowhere else on it.\n* The list has one `<a href=\"/admin/recaps/{id}\">` per row, in display order.\n  An Admin's filter form has fields named status, trip and owner; an Editor's\n  has status and trip only.\n* A malformed filter value (status not draft/submitted/published, trip or owner\n  not a whole number) is refused with 400 and is never echoed into the page. A\n  well-formed trip or owner that matches nothing gives an empty list. An\n  Editor's `owner` is ignored: they only ever see their own Recaps.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport time\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import accounts, cli, db, pages, recaps, seed, settings, site_state, trips\nfrom tests.conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03 import BOSTON, CHICAGO, account_id, count, post, recap_form\nfrom tests.test_t07 import page_form\n\nRECAPS = \"/admin/recaps\"\nLONG_AGO = \"2000-01-01T00:00:00Z\"\nBEFORE_THAT = \"1999-12-31T00:00:00Z\"\nNOTICE = \"changes not yet live\"\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef counts(html):\n    return {k: int(n) for k, n in\n            re.findall(r'data-count=\"([a-z-]+)\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html)}\n\n\ndef listed(c, **params):\n    \"\"\"Recap ids on the list page, in display order.\"\"\"\n    r = c.get(RECAPS, params=params)\n    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text\n    return [int(i) for i in re.findall(r'href=\"/admin/recaps/(\\d+)\"', r.text)]\n\n\ndef make(owner_id, trip_id, slug, status=\"draft\", title=None):\n    recap_id = recaps.create_recap(trip_id, owner_id, title or f\"Title {slug}\",\n                                   slug, \"A short anecdote.\", \"Jane Doe\", 2027)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"submit\")\n    if status == \"published\":\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"publish\")\n    return recap_id\n\n\nclass World:\n    \"\"\"Two Editors, two Trips, seven Recaps, three Pages, one Deactivated\n    Account. Admin sees: draft 2, submitted 3, published 2, trips 2, pages\n    draft 2 / published 1, active accounts 3 (Admin, two Editors).\"\"\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef world(database):\n    w = World()\n    w.admin = account_id(seed.ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    w.e1 = account_id(seed.EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    w.e2 = accounts.create_account(\"other.editor@example.test\", \"Other Editor\",\n                                   2027, \"editor\", \"other-editor-pw\")\n    gone = accounts.create_account(\"gone@example.test\", \"Gone Member\", 2025,\n                                   \"editor\", \"gone-pw\")\n    accounts.deactivate(gone)\n    w.chicago = trips.create_trip(dict(CHICAGO))\n    w.boston = trips.create_trip(dict(BOSTON))\n    w.r1 = make(w.e1, w.chicago, \"r1\", \"draft\")\n    w.r2 = make(w.e1, w.chicago, \"r2\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r3 = make(w.e1, w.boston, \"r3\", \"published\")\n    w.r4 = make(w.e2, w.chicago, \"r4\", \"draft\")\n    w.r5 = make(w.e2, w.boston, \"r5\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r6 = make(w.e2, w.boston, \"r6\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r7 = make(w.admin, w.boston, \"r7\", \"published\")\n    w.mine = {w.r1, w.r2, w.r3}\n    w.everything = w.mine | {w.r4, w.r5, w.r6, w.r7}\n    w.submitted = {w.r2, w.r5, w.r6}\n    for slug, nav in ((\"about\", 1), (\"officers\", 2), (\"history\", 3)):\n        pages.create_page(w.admin, slug.title(), slug, \"Text.\", nav)\n    pages.transition(1, \"publish\")\n    return w\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as, world):\n    return client_as(\"admin\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(client_as, world):\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef other_editor(world):\n    from tests.test_t03 import second_editor\n    return second_editor()\n\n\ndef pin_site_state(render_at):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_state (id, last_rendered_at) VALUES \"\n                     \"(1, ?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET \"\n                     \"last_rendered_at = excluded.last_rendered_at\",\n                     (render_at,))\n\n\ndef settle():\n    \"\"\"The world as it is right after `cms publish`: every row last touched\n    before the render, pinned far in the past so no test depends on the clock.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for table in (\"trip\", \"recap\", \"page\"):\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET created_at = ?, edited_at = ?\",\n                         (BEFORE_THAT, BEFORE_THAT))\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET published_at = ? \"\n                     \"WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL\", (BEFORE_THAT,))\n    pin_site_state(LONG_AGO)\n\n\ndef stamp_recap(recap_id, edited_at):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET edited_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (edited_at, recap_id))\n\n\n# ---- anonymous ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin\", RECAPS])\ndef test_anonymous_requests_redirect_to_login(client, path):\n    r = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code == 303\n    assert r.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n# ---- dashboard counts -----------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_dashboard_counts_match_the_data(admin):\n    assert counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 2, \"recaps-submitted\": 3, \"recaps-published\": 2,\n        \"trips\": 2, \"pages-draft\": 2, \"pages-published\": 1,\n        \"accounts-active\": 3}\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_an_account_lowers_the_active_count(admin, world):\n    accounts.deactivate(world.e2)\n    assert counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text)[\"accounts-active\"] == 2\n\n\ndef test_editor_dashboard_counts_only_their_own_recaps(editor, world):\n    assert counts(editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 1, \"recaps-submitted\": 1, \"recaps-published\": 1}\n\n\ndef test_editor_dashboard_does_not_move_when_others_recaps_change(\n        editor, world):\n    before = counts(editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    make(world.e2, world.chicago, \"another\", \"published\")\n    make(world.admin, world.chicago, \"admin-draft\", \"draft\")\n    assert counts(editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == before\n\n\ndef test_other_editor_sees_their_own_numbers(other_editor):\n    assert counts(other_editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 1, \"recaps-submitted\": 2, \"recaps-published\": 0}\n\n\n# ---- \"changes not yet live\" notice ----------------------------------------\n\ndef test_notice_shows_when_the_site_has_never_been_rendered(admin):\n    assert site_state.last_rendered() is None\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_notice_is_absent_right_after_a_render(admin):\n    settle()\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"change\", [\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/trips/%d\" % w.chicago, **{\n        **CHICAGO, \"summary\": \"Changed summary.\"}), id=\"edit-trip\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/trips\", **{\n        **BOSTON, \"slug\": \"2026-new\", \"city\": \"Newtown\"}), id=\"create-trip\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"%s/%d\" % (RECAPS, w.r1), **recap_form(\n        w.chicago, body=\"Edited.\", byline_name=\"Jane Doe\",\n        byline_class_year=\"2027\")), id=\"edit-recap\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"%s/%d/publish\" % (RECAPS, w.r2)),\n                 id=\"publish-recap\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"%s/%d/unpublish\" % (RECAPS, w.r3)),\n                 id=\"unpublish-recap\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/pages/1\", **page_form(\n        body=\"Edited page.\")), id=\"edit-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/pages/2/publish\"),\n                 id=\"publish-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/pages/1/unpublish\"),\n                 id=\"unpublish-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"%s/%d/delete\" % (RECAPS, w.r3)),\n                 id=\"delete-published-recap\"),\n])\ndef test_notice_appears_after_any_content_change(admin, world, change):\n    settle()\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n    r = change(admin, world)\n    assert r.status_code == 303, r.text\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_notice_cycle_with_the_real_cms_publish(admin, world, tmp_path,\n                                                monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n    time.sleep(1.1)  # the stamps have one-second precision\n    post(admin, \"/admin/pages/1\", **page_form(body=\"Edited after the render.\"))\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_edit_in_the_same_second_as_the_render_is_not_a_change(admin, world):\n    settle()\n    stamp_recap(world.r1, LONG_AGO)\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_edit_one_second_after_the_render_is_a_change(admin, world):\n    settle()\n    stamp_recap(world.r1, \"2000-01-01T00:00:01Z\")\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_edit_one_second_before_the_render_is_not_a_change(admin, world):\n    settle()\n    stamp_recap(world.r1, \"1999-12-31T23:59:59Z\")\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_editors_never_see_the_notice(editor, world):\n    assert site_state.last_rendered() is None\n    assert NOTICE not in editor.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\n# ---- Admin list: contents, filters, order ----------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_list_shows_every_recap(admin, world):\n    assert set(listed(admin)) == world.everything\n    assert len(listed(admin)) == 7\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status, expected\", [\n    (\"draft\", {\"r1\", \"r4\"}),\n    (\"submitted\", {\"r2\", \"r5\", \"r6\"}),\n    (\"published\", {\"r3\", \"r7\"}),\n])\ndef test_admin_filters_by_status(admin, world, status, expected):\n    assert set(listed(admin, status=status)) == {\n        getattr(world, n) for n in expected}\n\n\ndef test_admin_filters_by_trip(admin, world):\n    assert set(listed(admin, trip=world.chicago)) == {\n        world.r1, world.r2, world.r4}\n    assert set(listed(admin, trip=world.boston)) == {\n        world.r3, world.r5, world.r6, world.r7}\n\n\ndef test_admin_filters_by_owner(admin, world):\n    assert set(listed(admin, owner=world.e1)) == world.mine\n    assert set(listed(admin, owner=world.e2)) == {world.r4, world.r5, world.r6}\n    assert set(listed(admin, owner=world.admin)) == {world.r7}\n\n\ndef test_admin_filters_combine(admin, world):\n    assert set(listed(admin, status=\"submitted\", trip=world.boston)) == {\n        world.r5, world.r6}\n    assert set(listed(admin, status=\"submitted\", owner=world.e2)) == {\n        world.r5, world.r6}\n    assert set(listed(admin, trip=world.chicago, owner=world.e1)) == {\n        world.r1, world.r2}\n    assert listed(admin, status=\"published\", trip=world.boston,\n                  owner=world.e1) == [world.r3]\n    assert listed(admin, status=\"draft\", trip=world.boston,\n                  owner=world.e1) == []\n\n\ndef test_empty_filter_values_mean_no_filter(admin, world):\n    assert set(listed(admin, status=\"\", trip=\"\", owner=\"\")) == world.everything\n\n\ndef test_submitted_recaps_come_first_for_an_admin(admin, world):\n    ids = listed(admin)\n    assert set(ids[:3]) == world.submitted\n    assert set(ids[3:]) == world.everything - world.submitted\n\n\ndef test_submitted_first_holds_when_only_trip_is_filtered(admin, world):\n    ids = listed(admin, trip=world.boston)\n    assert set(ids[:2]) == {world.r5, world.r6}\n\n\ndef test_admin_filter_form_has_status_trip_and_owner(admin):\n    html = admin.get(RECAPS).text\n    for name in (\"status\", \"trip\", \"owner\"):\n        assert f'name=\"{name}\"' in html\n\n\n# ---- Editor list: own Recaps only ------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_editor_list_contains_only_their_own_recaps(editor, world):\n    assert set(listed(editor)) == world.mine\n    assert len(listed(editor)) == 3\n\n\ndef Dashboard and content list.\n\nSeams: the HTTP app (TestClient). Data is set up with the app's own write\nfunctions and routes; the pages are read back as a console user sees them.\n\n    GET /admin                                       the dashboard\n    GET /admin/recaps[?status=&trip=&owner=]         the Recaps list\n\nMarkup contract the tests read (the ticket leaves it open):\n\n* Each dashboard count is an element carrying `data-count=\"<key>\"` whose text is\n  the number. Admin keys: recaps-draft, recaps-submitted, recaps-published,\n  trips, pages-draft, pages-published, accounts-active. An Editor's dashboard\n  has the three recaps-* keys only.\n* The \"changes not yet live\" notice is the phrase \"changes not yet live\" on the\n  Admin dashboard, and appears nowhere else on it.\n* The list has one `<a href=\"/admin/recaps/{id}\">` per row, in display order.\n  An Admin's filter form has fields named status, trip and owner; an Editor's\n  has status and trip only.\n* A malformed filter value (status not draft/submitted/published, trip or owner\n  not a whole number) is refused with 400 and is never echoed into the page. A\n  well-formed trip or owner that matches nothing gives an empty list. An\n  Editor's `owner` is ignored: they only ever see their own Recaps.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport time\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import accounts, cli, db, pages, recaps, seed, settings, site_state, trips\nfrom tests.conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03 import BOSTON, CHICAGO, account_id, count, post, recap_form\nfrom tests.test_t07 import page_form\n\nRECAPS = \"/admin/recaps\"\nLONG_AGO = \"2000-01-01T00:00:00Z\"\nBEFORE_THAT = \"1999-12-31T00:00:00Z\"\nNOTICE = \"changes not yet live\"\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef counts(html):\n    return {k: int(n) for k, n in\n            re.findall(r'data-count=\"([a-z-]+)\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html)}\n\n\ndef listed(c, **params):\n    \"\"\"Recap ids on the list page, in display order.\"\"\"\n    r = c.get(RECAPS, params=params)\n    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text\n    return [int(i) for i in re.findall(r'href=\"/admin/recaps/(\\d+)\"', r.text)]\n\n\ndef make(owner_id, trip_id, slug, status=\"draft\", title=None):\n    recap_id = recaps.create_recap(trip_id, owner_id, title or f\"Title {slug}\",\n                                   slug, \"A short anecdote.\", \"Jane Doe\", 2027)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"submit\")\n    if status == \"published\":\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"publish\")\n    return recap_id\n\n\nclass World:\n    \"\"\"Two Editors, two Trips, seven Recaps, three Pages, one Deactivated\n    Account. Admin sees: draft 2, submitted 3, published 2, trips 2, pages\n    draft 2 / published 1, active accounts 3 (Admin, two Editors).\"\"\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef world(database):\n    w = World()\n    w.admin = account_id(seed.ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    w.e1 = account_id(seed.EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    w.e2 = accounts.create_account(\"other.editor@example.test\", \"Other Editor\",\n                                   2027, \"editor\", \"other-editor-pw\")\n    gone = accounts.create_account(\"gone@example.test\", \"Gone Member\", 2025,\n                                   \"editor\", \"gone-pw\")\n    accounts.deactivate(gone)\n    w.chicago = trips.create_trip(dict(CHICAGO))\n    w.boston = trips.create_trip(dict(BOSTON))\n    w.r1 = make(w.e1, w.chicago, \"r1\", \"draft\")\n    w.r2 = make(w.e1, w.chicago, \"r2\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r3 = make(w.e1, w.boston, \"r3\", \"published\")\n    w.r4 = make(w.e2, w.chicago, \"r4\", \"draft\")\n    w.r5 = make(w.e2, w.boston, \"r5\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r6 = make(w.e2, w.boston, \"r6\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r7 = make(w.admin, w.boston, \"r7\", \"published\")\n    w.mine = {w.r1, w.r2, w.r3}\n    w.everything = w.mine | {w.r4, w.r5, w.r6, w.r7}\n    w.submitted = {w.r2, w.r5, w.r6}\n    for slug, nav in ((\"about\", 1), (\"officers\", 2), (\"history\", 3)):\n        pages.create_page(w.admin, slug.title(), slug, \"Text.\", nav)\n    pages.transition(1, \"publish\")\n    return w\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as, world):\n    return client_as(\"admin\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(client_as, world):\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef other_editor(world):\n    from tests.test_t03 import second_editor\n    return second_editor()\n\n\ndef pin_site_state(render_at):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_state (id, last_rendered_at) VALUES \"\n                     \"(1, ?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET \"\n                     \"last_rendered_at = excluded.last_rendered_at\",\n                     (render_at,))\n\n\ndef settle():\n    \"\"\"The world as it is right after `cms publish`: every row last touched\n    before the render, pinned far in the past so no test depends on the clock.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for table in (\"trip\", \"recap\", \"page\"):\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET created_at = ?, edited_at = ?\",\n                         (BEFORE_THAT, BEFORE_THAT))\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET published_at = ? \"\n                     \"WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL\", (BEFORE_THAT,))\n    pin_site_state(LONG_AGO)\n\n\ndef stamp_recap(recap_id, edited_at):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET edited_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (edited_at, recap_id))\n\n\n# ---- anonymous ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin\", RECAPS])\ndef test_anonymous_requests_redirect_to_login(client, path):\n    r = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code == 303\n    assert r.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n# ---- dashboard counts -----------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_dashboard_counts_match_the_data(admin):\n    assert counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 2, \"recaps-submitted\": 3, \"recaps-published\": 2,\n        \"trips\": 2, \"pages-draft\": 2, \"pages-published\": 1,\n        \"accounts-active\": 3}\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_an_account_lowers_the_active_count(admin, world):\n    accounts.deactivate(world.e2)\n    assert counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text)[\"accounts-active\"] == 2\n\n\ndef test_editor_dashboard_counts_only_their_own_recaps(editor, world):\n    assert counts(editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 1, \"recaps-submitted\": 1, \"recaps-published\": 1}\n\n\ndef test_editor_dashboard_does_not_move_when_others_recaps_change(\n        editor, world):\n    before = counts(editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    make(world.e2, world.chicago, \"another\", \"published\")\n    make(world.admin, world.chicago, \"admin-draft\", \"draft\")\n    assert counts(editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == before\n\n\ndef test_other_editor_sees_their_own_numbers(other_editor):\n    assert counts(other_editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 1, \"recaps-submitted\": 2, \"recaps-published\": 0}\n\n\n# ---- \"changes not yet live\" notice ----------------------------------------\n\ndef test_notice_shows_when_the_site_has_never_been_rendered(admin):\n    assert site_state.last_rendered() is None\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_notice_is_absent_right_after_a_render(admin):\n    settle()\n    assert NOTICE not in summary.\"}), id=\"edit-trip\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/trips\", **{\n        **BOSTON, \"slug\": \"2026-new\", \"city\": \"Newtown\"}), id=\"create-trip\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"%s/%d\" % (RECAPS, w.r1), **recap_form(\n        w.chicago, body=\"Edited.\", byline_name=\"Jane Doe\",\n        byline_class_year=\"2027\")), id=\"edit-recap\"),\n           id=\"unpublish-recap\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/pages/1\", **page_form(\n        body=\"Edited page.\")), id=\"edit-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/pages/2/publish\"),\n                 id=\"publish-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/pages/1/unpublish\"),\n                 id=\"unpublish-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"%s/%d/delete\" % (RECAPS, w.r3)),\n                 id=\"delete-published-recap\"),\n])\ndef test_notice_appears_after_any_content_change(admin, world, change):\n    settle()\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n    r = change(admin, world)\n    assert r.status_code == 303, r.text\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_notice_cycle_with_the_real_cms_publish(admin, world, tmp_path,\n                                                monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n    time.sleep(1.1)  # the stamps have one-second precision\n    post(admin, \"/admin/pages/1\", **page_form(body=\"Edited after the render.\"))\n    assert test_edit_in_the_same_second_as_the_render_is_not_a_change(admin, world):\n    settle()\n    stamp_recap(world.r1, LONG_AGO)\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_edit_one_second_after_the_render_is_a_change(admin, world):\n    settle()\n    stamp_recap(world.r1, \"2000-01-01T00:00:01Z\")\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef {"parentUuid":"77635959-db85-4638-9004-c31fdd1d8aba","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"510df76d-23df-4c6a-b4db-4a6f34f42a94","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NM5RxJLp4tWiue8DB67YWE","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t08.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"c4d7e6c9-fb9d-4829-8a83-a1c1cb0d154c","timestamp":"2026-10-24T17:34:31.033Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t08.py","content":"\"\"\"T08: Dashboard and content list.\n\nSeams: the HTTP app (TestClient). Data is set up with the app's own write\nfunctions and routes; the pages are read back as a console user sees them.\n\n    GET /admin                                       the dashboard\n    GET /admin/recaps[?status=&trip=&owner=]         the Recaps list\n\nMarkup contract the tests read (the ticket leaves it open):\n\n* Each dashboard count is an element carrying `data-count=\"<key>\"` whose text is\n  the number. Admin keys: recaps-draft, recaps-submitted, recaps-published,\n  trips, pages-draft, pages-published, accounts-active. An Editor's dashboard\n  has the three recaps-* keys only.\n* The \"changes not yet live\" notice is the phrase \"changes not yet live\" on the\n  Admin dashboard, and appears nowhere else on it.\n* The list has one `<a href=\"/admin/recaps/{id}\">` per row, in display order.\n  An Admin's filter form has fields named status, trip and owner; an Editor's\n  has status and trip only.\n* A malformed filter value (status not draft/submitted/published, trip or owner\n  not a whole number) is refused with 400 and is never echoed into the page. A\n  well-formed trip or owner that matches nothing gives an empty list. An\n  Editor's `owner` is ignored: they only ever see their own Recaps.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport time\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import accounts, cli, db, pages, recaps, seed, settings, site_state, trips\nfrom tests.conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03 import BOSTON, CHICAGO, account_id, count, post, recap_form\nfrom tests.test_t07 import page_form\n\nRECAPS = \"/admin/recaps\"\nLONG_AGO = \"2000-01-01T00:00:00Z\"\nBEFORE_THAT = \"1999-12-31T00:00:00Z\"\nNOTICE = \"changes not yet live\"\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef counts(html):\n    return {k: int(n) for k, n in\n            re.findall(r'data-count=\"([a-z-]+)\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html)}\n\n\ndef listed(c, **params):\n    \"\"\"Recap ids on the list page, in display order.\"\"\"\n    r = c.get(RECAPS, params=params)\n    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text\n    return [int(i) for i in re.findall(r'href=\"/admin/recaps/(\\d+)\"', r.text)]\n\n\ndef make(owner_id, trip_id, slug, status=\"draft\", title=None):\n    recap_id = recaps.create_recap(trip_id, owner_id, title or f\"Title {slug}\",\n                                   slug, \"A short anecdote.\", \"Jane Doe\", 2027)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"submit\")\n    if status == \"published\":\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, \"publish\")\n    return recap_id\n\n\nclass World:\n    \"\"\"Two Editors, two Trips, seven Recaps, three Pages, one Deactivated\n    Account. Admin sees: draft 2, submitted 3, published 2, trips 2, pages\n    draft 2 / published 1, active accounts 3 (Admin, two Editors).\"\"\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef world(database):\n    w = World()\n    w.admin = account_id(seed.ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    w.e1 = account_id(seed.EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    w.e2 = accounts.create_account(\"other.editor@example.test\", \"Other Editor\",\n                                   2027, \"editor\", \"other-editor-pw\")\n    gone = accounts.create_account(\"gone@example.test\", \"Gone Member\", 2025,\n                                   \"editor\", \"gone-pw\")\n    accounts.deactivate(gone)\n    w.chicago = trips.create_trip(dict(CHICAGO))\n    w.boston = trips.create_trip(dict(BOSTON))\n    w.r1 = make(w.e1, w.chicago, \"r1\", \"draft\")\n    w.r2 = make(w.e1, w.chicago, \"r2\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r3 = make(w.e1, w.boston, \"r3\", \"published\")\n    w.r4 = make(w.e2, w.chicago, \"r4\", \"draft\")\n    w.r5 = make(w.e2, w.boston, \"r5\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r6 = make(w.e2, w.boston, \"r6\", \"submitted\")\n    w.r7 = make(w.admin, w.boston, \"r7\", \"published\")\n    w.mine = {w.r1, w.r2, w.r3}\n    w.everything = w.mine | {w.r4, w.r5, w.r6, w.r7}\n    w.submitted = {w.r2, w.r5, w.r6}\n    for slug, nav in ((\"about\", 1), (\"officers\", 2), (\"history\", 3)):\n        pages.create_page(w.admin, slug.title(), slug, \"Text.\", nav)\n    pages.transition(1, \"publish\")\n    return w\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as, world):\n    return client_as(\"admin\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef editor(client_as, world):\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef other_editor(world):\n    from tests.test_t03 import second_editor\n    return second_editor()\n\n\ndef pin_site_state(render_at):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_state (id, last_rendered_at) VALUES \"\n                     \"(1, ?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET \"\n                     \"last_rendered_at = excluded.last_rendered_at\",\n                     (render_at,))\n\n\ndef settle():\n    \"\"\"The world as it is right after `cms publish`: every row last touched\n    before the render, pinned far in the past so no test depends on the clock.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for table in (\"trip\", \"recap\", \"page\"):\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET created_at = ?, edited_at = ?\",\n                         (BEFORE_THAT, BEFORE_THAT))\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET published_at = ? \"\n                     \"WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL\", (BEFORE_THAT,))\n    pin_site_state(LONG_AGO)\n\n\ndef stamp_recap(recap_id, edited_at):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET edited_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (edited_at, recap_id))\n\n\n# ---- anonymous ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin\", RECAPS])\ndef test_anonymous_requests_redirect_to_login(client, path):\n    r = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code == 303\n    assert r.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n# ---- dashboard counts -----------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_dashboard_counts_match_the_data(admin):\n    assert counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 2, \"recaps-submitted\": 3, \"recaps-published\": 2,\n        \"trips\": 2, \"pages-draft\": 2, \"pages-published\": 1,\n        \"accounts-active\": 3}\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_an_account_lowers_the_active_count(admin, world):\n    accounts.deactivate(world.e2)\n    assert counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text)[\"accounts-active\"] == 2\n\n\ndef test_editor_dashboard_counts_only_their_own_recaps(editor, world):\n    assert counts(editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 1, \"recaps-submitted\": 1, \"recaps-published\": test_other_editor_sees_their_own_numbers(other_editor):\n    assert counts(other_editor.get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"recaps-draft\": 1, \"recaps-submitted\": 2, \"recaps-published\": \"/admin/pages/2/publish\"),\n                 id=\"publish-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"/admin/pages/1/unpublish\"),\n                 id=\"unpublish-page\"),\n    pytest.param(lambda a, w: post(a, \"%s/%d/delete\" % (RECAPS, w.r3)),\n                 id=\"delete-published-recap\"),\n])\ndef test_notice_appears_after_any_content_change(admin, world, change):\n    settle()\n    assert NOTICE not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n    r = change(admin, world)\n    assert r.status_code == 303, r.text\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_notice_cycle_with_the_real_cms_publish(admin, world, tmp_path,\n                                                monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert NOTICE in admin.get(\"/admin\").text.lower()\n\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    assert NOTICE not in Every failure is an assertion about the missing feature. The fixtures and imports work: the world fixture builds, and the logins, posts and page loads all succeed.\n\n**Failures grouped by reason**\n\n| Reason | Tests |\n|---|---|\n| No `data-count` markup on the dashboard, which is still the T00 hello page | 5 (counts for Admin, Editor and the other Editor, plus active-account counting) |\n| No \"changes not yet live\" notice | 12: never rendered (1), after each kind of change (9), the real `cms publish` cycle (1), edit one second after render (1) |\n| The list ignores `status`, `trip` and `owner` | 11: status (3), trip, owner, combined, empty-match, Editor status/trip, Editor owner can't widen, repeated param |\n| Submitted Recaps are not listed first | 2 |\n| The list has no filter form | 3: Admin has status/trip/owner, Editor has status and trip only, no other Editor's data on the Editor page |\n| Bad filter values return 200 instead of 400 | 24: hostile `status` (9), `trip`/`owner` (14), Editor-side check (1) |\n\n**Passing tests**\n- Anonymous requests redirect to login.\n- Editors don't see the notice.\n- The Editor list is already own-only, and the owner param can't reveal others.\n- Same-second and one-second-earlier edits don't trigger the notice.\n- Titles are escaped.\n- Post forms carry CSRF tokens.\n\nThese pass already; they guard behaviour that must not regress.\n\n**Decisions for you**\n1. **Markup contract.** The ticket doesn't fix the markup, so I chose one. It's in the file's docstring: `data-count=\"<key>\"`, the phrase \"changes not yet live\", filter fields named `status`, `trip` and `owner`. A malformed filter value returns 400. A well-formed id that matches nothing gives an empty list. An Editor's `owner` is ignored.\n2. **Same-second comparison.** An edit at or before the render second is not a change. An edit one second later is. The other choice would leave a permanent false notice after `cms publish`.\n3. **Publish, Unpublish and delete.** Today these don't stamp `edited_at`. I wrote tests that expect the notice after Publish and Unpublish of a Recap and a Page, and after deleting a Published Recap. Publish and Unpublish would need `transition` in `app/recaps.py` and `app/pages.py` to stamp the edit time. Deletes leave no timestamp, so they'd need something extra, such as a `content_changed_at` column on `site_state`. If you'd rather drop the delete case, say so and I'll remove it.\n4. **One slow test.** The `cms publish` cycle test sleeps 1.1 seconds, because the stamps have one-second precision. The other time-based tests pin their timestamps.\n5. **Skill seam rule.** The tdd skill wants seams confirmed before tests are written. I used your stop-and-wait gate instead. The seam is the HTTP app, as in the earlier tickets.\n\n**Minimal unblocking:** nothing is blocked by setup.
